news.title: Price target decreased by 17% to ₹654
news.body: Down from ₹787, the current price target is an average from 8 analysts. New target price is 28% above last closing price of ₹510. Stock is down 33% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹19.12 for next year compared to ₹17.42 last year.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.42 (up from ₹16.44 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹54.8b (up 17% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹13.9b (up 6.0% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 26% (down from 28% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 10%. Revenue is forecast to grow 7.9% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Commercial Services industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 12% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 7% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.body: Analysts have reduced their price target for Indian Railway Catering & Tourism to ₹1,157.74. This reflects slightly adjusted assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E, while keeping the stock's fair value view unchanged.

news.title: IRCTC: Dividend Payout And Margin Assumptions Will Likely Keep Shares Fairly Valued
news.body: Analysts have kept the ₹537 price target for Indian Railway Catering & Tourism unchanged, citing revised assumptions that now pair a 3.37% revenue growth outlook with a 32.48% profit margin and a forward P/E of about 33.89x. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for March 24, 2026 to review comments on fines levied by the exchanges for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, and to consider a change in the nomination of the Chief Investor Relations Officer (company filing).

news.title: IRCTC: Interim Dividend And Board Actions Will Support Future Upside

What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for March 24, 2026, to review and approve comments on fines levied by the exchanges for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, and to consider a change in the nomination of the Chief Investor Relations Officer (company filing).

news.title: IRCTC: Steady Fair Value And Interim Dividend Will Support Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept the fair value estimate for Indian Railway Catering & Tourism steady at ₹768.50, reflecting unchanged assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E. Together, these factors support a maintained price target rather than a recalibrated one.

news.title: IRCTC: Higher Margins And Dividend Will Likely Keep Shares Fairly Priced
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their 12 month price target for Indian Railway Catering & Tourism from ₹569 to ₹537, citing updated assumptions for slightly softer revenue growth, a higher profit margin profile, and a lower future P/E multiple. What's in the News The Board declared a 2nd interim dividend of ₹3.50 per share on equity shares with a face value of ₹2 each, described as 175% for FY 2025-26, following its meeting on February 12, 2026 (company announcement).

news.title: IRCTC: Second Interim Dividend Will Support Constructive Forward Share Price View
news.body: The analyst price target for Indian Railway Catering & Tourism has been revised from ₹800.25 to ₹768.50, with analysts citing updated assumptions on revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E as the key drivers of this change. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on February 12, 2026 to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, following Audit Committee review (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.93 (vs ₹4.26 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.93 (up from ₹4.26 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹15.2b (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.94b (up 16% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 26% (down from 28% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 5.7% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 9.9% growth forecast for the Commercial Services industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 2% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: IRCTC: Upcoming Board Meeting And Interim Dividend Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target for Indian Railway Catering & Tourism slightly lower to reflect a mildly reduced future P/E assumption of 73.74x and a small adjustment to the discount rate to 12.48%, while keeping fair value broadly unchanged around ₹1,157.31 because updated estimates for revenue growth and profit margins remain close to prior levels. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for February 12, 2026 to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025, after Audit Committee review (company filing).

news.title: Indian Railway Catering And Tourism Corporation Limited Announces Cessation Of Shri Manoj Kumar Gangeya as Executive Director (Planning) and Part-time Government Director, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited has announced that Shri Manoj Kumar Gangeya has relinquished the charge of the post of Executive Director (Planning), Railway Board, with effect from January 16, 2026, and accordingly ceases to be the Part-time Government Director on the Board of the Company with effect from January 16, 2026. The cessation of directorship follows the Railway Board's Order No. 2026/E(O)II/5/2 dated January 12, 2026.
